label: r4c3
name: Fourier positions fed into head
hypothesis: This is r3c2, the only trial to score (0.35), with extra position input. Sine and cosine position channels are added at the input, and the position channels are also concatenated into the pooling head. Positional cues were what made r3c2 learn, so giving the head position directly should make that learning more reliable and narrow the gap between seeds (0.15 vs 0.54). Refuted if the mean is at or below r3c2's 0.35.
